Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 ln_cnt NUMBER;
BEGIN
 --nullchk;
 --check_package_failure;
 IF :CTRL_BLK_1.PROC_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT REGEXP_INSTR(TRIM(:ctrl_blk_1.proc_code),'[^a-z^A-Z^0-9]') INTO ln_cnt FROM dual;
 IF ln_cnt > 0 THEN
 -- Enter alpha numeric characters only.
 show_error('9740');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 --:proc_def.proc_code := :ctrl_blk_1.proc_code;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 ln_cnt NUMBER;
BEGIN
 
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.proc_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled,
 :GLOBAL.tz_offset, 
 SYSDATE); 
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.inclterm = 'Y' THEN 
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO ln_cnt
 FROM valid_emf_proc_def
 WHERE proc_code = :ctrl_blk_1.proc_code;
 --AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate); 
 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO ln_cnt
 FROM valid_emf_proc_def
 WHERE proc_code = :ctrl_blk_1.proc_code
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate); 
 END IF;
 
 IF ln_cnt = 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO ln_cnt
 FROM valid_emf_proc_def
 WHERE proc_code = :ctrl_blk_1.proc_code;
 
 IF ln_cnt <> 0 THEN
 show_error('24000');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 GO_ITEM('proc_def.proc_desc');
 ELSE
 GO_BLOCK('proc_def');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 GO_ITEM('proc_def.proc_desc');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
BEGIN
 :global.program_version := '01'; 

 execute_trigger('util_banner');

 :ctrl_blk_1.proc_code := NULL; 
 :ctrl_blk_1.inclterm := 'N';
 :ctrl_blk_1.chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled,
 :GLOBAL.tz_offset,
 SYSDATE);
 
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.proc_code');
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(:banner.hdr_date) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(:banner.hdr_date) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_PROC_CODE_RG0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT 
 proc_code, 
 SUBSTR(proc_desc, 1, 100), 
 TO_CHAR(eff_date, 'MM-DD-YYYY'),
 TO_CHAR(term_date, 'MM-DD-YYYY')
FROM valid_emf_proc_def
WHERE UPPER(proc_code) LIKE :CTRL_BLK_1.proc_code || '%'
 AND (:ctrl_blk_1.inclterm = 'Y' OR
 :ctrl_blk_1.chp_sysdate < NVL(term_date, :ctrl_blk_1.chp_sysdate + 1)
)
ORDER BY 1
